0022600196.text: The 76ers (8-2, 1st in the Atlantic and 1st in the East) come in on a one-game losing streak, with a 4-1 road record, while the Bulls (1-7, 14th in the East, 5 games back in the Central) have lost six straight and are 0-2 at home. Philadelphia leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 126-107 win in Philadelphia on November 2, and the 76ers lost 1-2 to Chicago in the 2025-26 season. Philadelphia is missing Adem Bona (out, back sprain), Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), while Chicago is without Nic Claxton (out, hamstring strain) and has Jalen Smith and Zach Collins listed as day-to-day with hand and illness issues.
